title: /discover/events/<slug> is a prerendered twin of /events/<slug> that nothing links to

source.ref: found 2026-10-05 by the scan-seven SEO/GEO finders (26-agent fan-out), confirmed by hand against the tree

detail: FOUND 2026-10-05 (scan seven, seo-urls finder). app/discover/events/[slug]/ has a page with generateStaticParams, a loading file and its own opengraph-image.tsx, so every public event is built twice, and a grep of app/, components/ and lib/ finds no link to it but its own self-references. SCAN-668 already pointed its og:url and breadcrumb at the canonical. THE FIX: a redirect { source: '/discover/events/:slug', destination: '/events/:slug', permanent: true } in next.config.ts (the single segment does not shadow /discover/events/in/... or /discover/events/organizer/...; lib/marketing/redirect-shadow.test.ts confirms), then delete the segment and update the two gate tests that name its OG file (scripts/build-fanout.test.ts, scripts/check-tokens.test.ts).

verify.cmd: node -e 'const fs=require("fs");if(fs.existsSync("app/discover/events/[slug]/page.tsx")){console.error("SCAN-672: /discover/events/<slug> still exists as a prerendered twin of /events/<slug> (its own page, loading and OG image route per event), reachable only by its own self-references; a 308 to /events/:slug retires it and halves the per-event build.");process.exit(1)}'
verify.note: Measures the consequence; fails until the fix lands.
